description: This file defines an abstract C# class 'FieldCodecTester' within the 'Orleans.Serialization.TestKit' namespace. The class provides a comprehensive suite of automated tests for verifying the correctness of serializers and codecs for a specific type 'TValue' and its associated 'TCodec'. It includes methods for serialization/deserialization round-trip tests, buffer handling, reference counting, skipping fields, bit stream validation, and collection/routing tests, primarily using Xunit.

classes.name: FieldCodecTester
classes.description: An abstract class providing a comprehensive suite of tests to verify the correctness and robustness of serializers and codecs for specific data types within the Orleans serialization framework. It serves as a base for concrete implementations testing particular types, enabling validation of serialization correctness, buffer handling, reference counting, skipping, and collection serialization.

methods.name: CorrectlyAdvancesReferenceCounterStream
methods.description: Tests that the serializer codec correctly updates reference counters when writing to and reading from a stream.

methods.name: CorrectlyAdvancesReferenceCounter
methods.description: Validates that reference counting updates correctly when using pipes with the codec.

methods.name: CanRoundTripViaSerializer_StreamPooled
methods.description: Checks that the value serializes and deserializes correctly using pooled streams.

methods.name: CanRoundTripViaSerializer_Span
methods.description: Validates round-trip serialization/deserialization when using spans.

methods.name: CanRoundTripViaSerializer_Array
methods.description: Checks that an array of test values can be serialized and deserialized correctly.

methods.name: CanRoundTripViaSerializer_Memory
methods.description: Validates round-trip serialization/deserialization using Memory<byte>.

methods.name: CanRoundTripViaSerializer_MemoryStream
methods.description: Verifies correct serialization/deserialization via MemoryStream.

methods.name: CanRoundTripViaSerializer_ReadByteByByte
methods.description: Simulates fragmented reads by reading byte-by-byte, ensuring correctness of serialization.

methods.name: ProducesValidBitStream
methods.description: Ensures that the serialized data produces a valid bit stream format.

methods.name: WritersProduceSameResults
methods.description: Checks that different buffer writers produce identical bit streams.

methods.name: CanRoundTripCollectionViaSerializer
methods.description: Confirms that collections of test values are correctly serialized and deserialized.

methods.name: CanRoundTripWeaklyTypedCollectionViaSerializer
methods.description: Verifies serialization/deserialization of weakly typed collections.

methods.name: CanRoundTripTupleViaSerializer
methods.description: Tests serialization of tuple types with mixed data.

methods.name: CanRoundTripViaSerializer
methods.description: Validates round-trip serialization/deserialization of individual TValue instances.

methods.name: CanRoundTripViaObjectSerializer
methods.description: Verifies round-trip of TValue via object serializer, ensuring type-agnostic deserialization.

methods.name: RoundTrippedValuesEqual
methods.description: Checks that a value, when round-tripped through the codec, remains equal to the original.

methods.name: CanRoundTripDefaultValueViaCodec
methods.description: Checks that default(TValue) can be serialized and deserialized correctly.

methods.name: CanBeSkipped
methods.description: Verifies that a value can be skipped correctly during deserialization.

methods.name: CanSkipDefaultValue
methods.description: Verifies that default values can be skipped during deserialization.

methods.name: CorrectlyHandlesBuffers
methods.description: Tests serialization/deserialization correctness across different buffer types and segment sizes.

methods.name: TestRoundTrippedValue
methods.description: Helper method to serialize and deserialize a value, then verify equality.

methods.name: RoundTripThroughCodec
methods.description: Serializes and deserializes a value via a strongly typed codec, checking correctness.

methods.name: RoundTripThroughUntypedSerializer
methods.description: Serializes and deserializes an object via an untyped serializer, returning the deserialized object and formatted bit stream.
